decisionScope: One isolated equal-strength strike per valid frozen P1 solver node. No DSP, routing, Plate, substrate or simulation change.

topology.graph: P1 compiled neighborIndices; four cardinal solver edges; geodesic distance is unweighted edge count
topology.boundary: true when degree < 4 because at least one cardinal solver neighbor is absent
topology.strikePosition: nearest occupied 96x96 P1 source-mask pixel to each target solver-node center; records offset, including edge-only compiled nodes

distanceDefinitions.euclidean: distance between solver-node centers and compiled pickup-node centers; normalized XY and solver-grid-cell units
distanceDefinitions.geodesic: shortest-path edge count over compiled P1 neighbor graph from each compiled pickup node

metricDefinitions.peak: maximum absolute PCM sample over the 500 ms post-strike window; pooled peak = max(L peak, R peak)
metricDefinitions.rms: event-aligned [strike frame, strike frame + duration); pooled RMS = sqrt((sum L^2 + sum R^2)/(2N))
metricDefinitions.amplitudes: raw float32 PCM after unchanged output gain and soft limiter; no normalization

scale.audio: fixed existing ANT linear grayscale -100..0 dBFS, no normalization
